subject: microbiology
title: Cestodes and trematodes: taenia, hydatid, schistosoma and flukes

steps.tx: **Taenia solium** (pork, armed rostellum with hooklets, gravid segments with fewer branches) causes intestinal **taeniasis** (undercooked pork, niclosamide or praziquantel) and, via eggs, **cysticercosis** with **neurocysticercosis** (seizures from parenchymal ring lesions, ocular and subcutaneous nodules, stool carrier in household). Treatment is **albendazole with steroids** (cysticidal inflammation swells fatally without cover) plus antiepileptics; ventricular or ocular disease needs surgery. **T. saginata** (beef, unarmed, motile segments) stays intestinal; **Hymenolepis nana** (dwarf, autoinfection in children, niclosamide) needs family hygiene.
steps.say: Pork tapeworm eggs seed brain rings: albendazole under steroid cover. Beef segments wander motile but stay gut.

steps.tx: **Echinococcus granulosus** (dog sheep cycle, eggs in canine faeces) forms **hydatid cysts** (liver commonest, **eggshell calcification**, daughter cysts with hydatid sand, anaphylaxis on leak) diagnosed by ultrasound WHO staging with arc 5 serology; treatment is **albendazole** with **PAIR** (puncture, aspirate, inject scolicidal, reaspirate) or surgery with scolicidal packing, never blind biopsy spilling. **E. multilocularis** (foxes, alveolar infiltrative, mimics malignancy, prolonged albendazole) invades like cancer. Deworm dogs with offal control.
steps.say: Liver cyst with eggshell rim is hydatid: albendazole plus PAIR, never blind needle. Spill causes anaphylaxis.

steps.tx: **Schistosoma** (snail, fork tailed cercariae penetrating skin, **Katayama fever** with eosinophilia weeks after exposure) species sort by eggs and veins: **haematobium** (terminal spine, vesical plexus, painless **terminal haematuria**, **squamous bladder cancer**, praziquantel), **mansoni** (lateral spine, mesenteric, **pipe stem fibrosis** with haematemesis), **japonicum** (small knob, zoonotic, cerebral seizures). Chronic inflammation fibroses; **praziquantel** kills adults (repeat for maturing worms) with steroids in neuroschistosomiasis. Stool or urine filtration with serology diagnoses.
steps.say: Terminal bloody urine with terminal spined eggs is haematobium: praziquantel. Pipe stem liver with lateral spines is mansoni.

steps.tx: **Liver flukes** (**Fasciola hepatica** sheep watercress, acute hepatitis with eosinophilia then cholangitis, **triclabendazole**; **Clonorchis and Opisthorchis** raw fish, recurrent pyogenic cholangitis with **cholangiocarcinoma**, praziquantel) ascend bile ducts. **Paragonimus** (crab crayfish, **haemoptysis mimicking TB** with ring shadows, praziquantel) expectorates eggs; **Fasciolopsis** (giant intestinal, water chestnut) stays luminal. Cook fish and crabs; snail control with sanitation breaks cycles.
steps.say: Raw fish cholangitis turning malignant is Clonorchis: praziquantel. Crab haemoptysis mimicking TB is Paragonimus.
